acceptanceCriteria: When the latest ci-control-plane status on the head SHA is a success by a non-bot creator, the PR job posts nothing (or reposts success) instead of failure
A new push still gets the failure status until an admin reviews it
The behavior is specified in the AFP spec with a requirement ID and checked by the workflow's test or a recorded hosted run
body: Observed 2026-10-18 on PR #1105 head 430e7e046: the owner-authorized admin success (20:18Z) was replaced by a github-actions[bot] failure at 20:49Z, when a later CI completion on the same SHA re-ran the control-plane job (.github/workflows/ci-control-plane.yml, job control-plane, posts state=failure for any .github/ change). The PR then sat BLOCKED with no signal until inspected; the admin had to repost. PR #1144's concurrency change (AFP-V0-079) does not address this. Expected: the job leaves an existing admin (non-bot) success on the exact head SHA in place.
title: ci-control-plane PR job overwrites an admin-posted success with failure when CI reruns on the same head
